# Microsoft Support

> > Official support hub for Microsoft products including Windows, Microsoft 365, Office, Edge, OneDrive, Copilot, and Microsoft account services.

Microsoft Support provides comprehensive help documentation, troubleshooting guides, installation instructions, and customer service resources for both home users and business customers. The site covers all major Microsoft products with multilingual support and direct contact options.

## Key Topics

- Windows 10
- Windows 11
- Microsoft 365
- Office
- Microsoft Edge
- Microsoft account
- Windows Update
- OneDrive
- Copilot
- Windows Security
- Microsoft Defender SmartScreen
- Outlook.com
- Installation guides
- Troubleshooting
- Customer service

## Product Support Hubs

- [Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us): Main Microsoft Support homepage for products and services help
- [Windows help and learning](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows): Windows support hub covering installation, updates, and security
- [Microsoft Edge help & learning](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge): Microsoft Edge support hub with tutorials and troubleshooting guides
- [Account help](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/account): Microsoft account setup, security, and management support hub

## Windows Installation and Updates

- [Ways to install Windows 11 - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/ways-to-install-windows-11-e0edbbfb-cfc5-4011-868b-2ce77ac7c70e): Installation methods and system requirements for Windows 11 upgrade
- [Install Windows Updates - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/install-windows-updates-3c5ae7fc-9fb6-9af1-1984-b5e0412c556a): How to check for and install Windows Updates for security and stability
- [Recovery Drive - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/recovery-drive-abb4691b-5324-6d4a-8766-73fab304c246): Create Windows recovery USB drive for system restore and reinstallation
- [Uninstall or remove apps and programs in Windows - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/uninstall-or-remove-apps-and-programs-in-windows-4b55f974-2cc6-2d2b-d092-5905080eaf98): How to uninstall apps and programs in Windows 10 and Windows 11

## Microsoft 365 and Office

- [在电脑或 Mac 上下载、安装或重新安装 Microsoft 365 或 Office 2024 - Microsoft 支持](https://support.microsoft.com/zh-cn/office/在电脑或-mac-上下载-安装或重新安装-microsoft-365-或-office-2024-4414eaaf-0478-48be-9c42-23adc4716658): Guide for installing Microsoft 365 and Office 2024 on PC or Mac
- [Microsoft 365 Customer Service and Support - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/microsoft-365-customer-service-and-support-96162163-b3aa-498b-bbbb-5e757b0f31da): Microsoft 365 support policy and options for home and business users
- [Converting documents to a newer format - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/converting-documents-to-a-newer-format-34ec742e-f0f9-4d95-bbe3-3ee8e30a86fa): Convert Word documents to newer formats for compatibility and features

## Customer Service and Contact

- [Contact Us - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/contactus): Contact Microsoft Support for help with products and services
- [Customer service phone numbers - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/topic/customer-service-phone-numbers-c0389ade-5640-e588-8b0e-28de8afeb3f2): Phone numbers for Microsoft business support and home user contact links
